title: Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.32866v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods capture the full parameter changes introduced during training, they are not easily interpretable. We present the full method of TopKLoRA, extending the preliminary proposal of Masiak et al. (2025), an interpretable-by-design LoRA variant in which only the $k$ largest adapter latents are active at each token. Unlike SAEs, TopKLoRA is trained purely on downstream loss, where optimisation pressure incentivises learning functionally causal latents. We demonstrate this sparse LoRA adapter in a sleeper-agent backdoor case study where we create model organisms by fine-tuning gemma-2-2b, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Qwen2.5-7B on a poisoned instruction-following dataset. translated_title: 基于TopKLoRA的可解释稀疏微调实现忠实的电路发现
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2610.32866v1，公告类型：cross）：在来源未知的数据集上进行微调时，如果数据中包含被投毒的样本，可能会在被训练的模型中植入后门。后门难以定位和移除，并且可以在安全训练之后持续存在。虽然参数高效微调方法能够捕捉训练过程中引入的全部参数变化，但它们不易于解释。我们提出了TopKLoRA的完整方法，该方法扩展了Masiak等人（2025）的初步提案，这是一种设计上即可解释的LoRA变体，其中在每个token上只有$k$个最大的适配器潜在变量处于激活状态。与稀疏自编码器（SAE）不同，TopKLoRA完全基于下游损失进行训练，其中优化压力会促使模型学习在功能上具有因果作用的潜在变量。我们在一个休眠代理（sleeper-agent）后门案例研究中展示了这种稀疏LoRA适配器：我们通过在投毒的指令遵循数据集上微调gemma-2-2b、Qwen2.5-1.5B和Qwen2.5-7B来创建模型生物体（model organisms）。对于每个生物体，我们识别并……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了设计上即可解释的稀疏微调方法TopKLoRA，通过在每个token上仅激活k个最大的适配器潜在变量、纯粹以下游损失训练，使其潜在变量在功能上具有因果性，从而能够忠实地发现休眠代理后门等模型内部电路。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TopKLoRA, an interpretable-by-design sparse fine-tuning method that activates only the k largest adapter latents per token and is trained purely on downstream loss, yielding functionally causal latents that enable faithful discovery of internal model circuits such as sleeper-agent backdoors.
